changes.comment: Daily notes: Mod+\ opens today's note, creating it if it is not there — in the format and folder your own .obsidian/daily-notes.json already says (DD-M-Y in Daily/, or Obsidian's YYYY-MM-DD default when there is no config).

Mod+- and Mod+= step to the previous and next daily note that actually exists, in date order rather than filename order, starting from the open note's own date (or today when it is not a daily). They are inert at either end instead of opening nothing.

History: a new sidebar section lists the earlier versions of the open note — every one Editor kept before writing the file — with the time and size of each, and restores one behind a confirm. Nothing new is recorded to make this work: it reads the pre-image journal that has always been there.
Right-click a note in the file tree and choose History… to open it with its versions showing.
Restoring a version puts the note back everywhere it is open and for everyone you share it with, and journals what it replaced — so the restore itself can be undone from the same list.
Editor can now read Obsidian's .obsidian/ configuration directory as well as its own .editor/. Read-only: Obsidian's settings are still Obsidian's.
